body.x: A child's growth check and an older adult's bone-health checkup have little in common on the surface. Both, however, come down to reading the condition of the skeleton.
GEMSS Healthcare Co., Ltd. was named a 2027 Honoree in Digital Health at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for XPLUS microTOMO, a mobile all-in-one X-ray system.

The system integrates four capabilities: real-time low-dose C-arm imaging, rotation-free 3D tomosynthesis, AI-assisted BMD screening for adults and older adults, and AI-assisted bone-age analysis for children and adolescents.

For musculoskeletal imaging and procedures, it provides real-time 2D fluoroscopy. When depth information is needed, only the X-ray source moves linearly to acquire multi-angle projections, without rotating the C-arm around the patient, and the projections are reconstructed into 3D tomosynthesis images available for review within 45 seconds.

Life-stage-specific AI analysis supports different bone-health needs. Hand X-rays of adults and older adults are analyzed for bone-density-related information to support low-BMD screening, while those of children and adolescents are analyzed for bone age and skeletal maturity to support growth assessment and treatment planning.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.

Ahead of CES 2027, AVING NEWS will host the 3rd Innovation Awards Winners Networking Party at MIK BASE CAMP on Wednesday, November 25, at 5 p.m. The event will also feature individual video interviews with participating companies, with registration available through Eventus. In early December, AVING NEWS will begin its pre-show coverage, including an interview program connecting Korean innovators with U.S. media outlets that regularly cover CES and participate in the Innovation Awards judging process.
